## Trace 3: App Store submission night

`https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/apps`

## Trace 13: Restart, rediscovery, and release

- Manual restart
- Rediscovery that the app was already in `PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE`
- Human green light to launch
- Final transition to `READY_FOR_SALE`

### Initial heartbeat status check

At the start of trace 13, the heartbeat instruction again tells the agent to read `HEARTBEAT.md`, follow it, and reply `HEARTBEAT_OK` if nothing needs attention.

> Next: Awaiting human approval to Release

> `ID: 69814814-a92d-4984-971a-d1a4852ba728  State: PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE  Version: 1.0`

The agent then sent a POST request to:

`https://api.appstoreconnect.apple.com/v1/appStoreVersionReleaseRequests`

with a relationship to app store version ID:

`69814814-a92d-4984-971a-d1a4852ba728`

- Type: `appStoreVersionReleaseRequests`
- ID: `69814814-a92d-4984-971a-d1a4852ba728`

`State: READY_FOR_SALE`

- It was live on the App Store

> App status is still `PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE` — already notified A and waiting for release approval. Nothing new to act on.  
> HEARTBEAT_OK

`https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760207382`

- “App is LIVE!”
- Status changed to `READY_FOR_SALE`
- App Store URL

- This completed the objective

2. Created and hosted support/privacy-policy pages on GitHub Pages.
